item.subject: science
item.stem:
The diagram shows a pinhole camera. Farhan points the tiny hole at a bright lamp and looks at the screen at the back.

What image should form on the screen?

options.A: An upside-down image of the lamp, also reversed left to right.
options.B: An upright image of the lamp, reversed left to right.
options.C: A bright patch with the same shape as the pinhole, not an image of the lamp.
options.D: An upside-down image of the lamp even if the pinhole faces away from the lamp.
